```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ranger)
  library(caret)
})

set.seed(1)

# 2. Load Data
historic <- read.csv("historic_property_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
predict_data <- read.csv("predict_property_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 3. Clean & Preprocess Data
clean_data <- function(df, is_train = TRUE) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      # Target log transformation (only for training)
      log_price = if (is_train) log(sale_price) else NA_real_,
      
      # Clean key numerical features
      char_bldg_sf = ifelse(is.na(char_bldg_sf), median(char_bldg_sf, na.rm = TRUE), char_bldg_sf),
      char_land_sf = ifelse(is.na(char_land_sf), median(char_land_sf, na.rm = TRUE), char_land_sf),
      char_age     = ifelse(is.na(char_age), median(char_age, na.rm = TRUE), char_age),
      char_beds    = ifelse(is.na(char_beds), 0, char_beds),
      char_rooms   = ifelse(is.na(char_rooms), 0, char_rooms),
      
      # Convert structural and geographic identifiers to factors
      meta_town_code = as.factor(meta_town_code)
    )
  return(df)
}

train_clean <- clean_data(historic, is_train = TRUE)
test_clean  <- clean_data(predict_data, is_train = FALSE)
```
